part.name: Tapered clevis-to-hook link arm
part.description: Single solid, tapered beam-like link with a forked clevis/pin interface on one end and a hooked/notched end with a small cylindrical post/boss on the opposite end. Geometry is largely prismatic with several cylindrical blends and cylindrical interface surfaces.
part.symmetry_note: Largely symmetric about the XZ mid-plane (y=0): clevis lugs and many exterior faces appear mirrored left/right in y.

Section.name: Clevis / Fork End
features included: Forked clevis (two lugs) with central slot
Two coaxial pin-hole bores (one in each lug) for a clevis pin
Clevis slot end wall / internal stop face
Outer rounded lug-end profiles (large radius cylinders)
Section.function intent: Provide a pinned mounting interface to a mating tab/rod-end, allowing rotation about the pin axis while transmitting axial/tensile/compressive load into the arm.
Section.physical behavior: Carries bearing/contact pressure in the pin bores, resists lug spreading under load, and transfers shear/bending from the pin joint into the tapered beam. The rounded lug ends reduce stress concentration at the clevis tip.
Section.geometry: Two parallel lugs separated by a rectangular slot; each lug contains a through-bore (cylindrical surface) with axis along +Y. The clevis tip has large-radius cylindrical outer surfaces, and the slot terminates at a planar end wall.
Section.location: Negative X end of the part (approximately x from -75.75 to about -60.75).

major_faces.name: Clevis inner face (Y-)
major_faces.description: Planar inner face of the clevis slot at y=-3.5, forming one side of the fork gap.

major_faces.name: Pin bore (lug Y-)
major_faces.description: Cylindrical through-bore surface in the negative-Y lug; pin axis along Y, radius ~3.

major_faces.name: Outer lug-end round (Y-)
major_faces.description: Large-radius cylindrical outer surface forming the rounded tip of the negative-Y lug (radius ~7.5).

major_faces.name: Clevis inner face (Y+)
major_faces.description: Planar inner face of the clevis slot at y=+3.5, forming the other side of the fork gap.

major_faces.name: Pin bore (lug Y+)
major_faces.description: Cylindrical through-bore surface in the positive-Y lug; pin axis along Y, radius ~3.

major_faces.name: Outer lug-end round (Y+)
major_faces.description: Large-radius cylindrical outer surface forming the rounded tip of the positive-Y lug (radius ~7.5).

major_faces.name: Clevis slot end wall
major_faces.description: Planar wall at the inboard end of the clevis slot (normal -X), acting as a stop/transition into the beam.

Section.name: Tapered Beam / Main Web
features included: Primary top and bottom planes (slightly angled)
Primary side planes (slightly angled) forming the beam width
Smooth transition regions into both end interfaces
Section.function intent: Act as the primary structural member connecting the clevis end to the hook end, providing reach while minimizing mass via tapering.
Section.physical behavior: Primarily resists axial load with bending/deflection under off-axis loading. The taper reduces material where bending moment is lower, while the wide/thicker regions near the ends support higher stress and interface loads.
Section.geometry: Four dominant planar faces (top, bottom, and two sides) forming a tapered/wedge-like beam along X; planes are slightly skewed (non-orthogonal normals) consistent with linear taper in thickness/width.
Section.location: Mid-span of the part from clevis root toward hook root (approximately x from about -67.99 to about +63.81, with side planes spanning nearly full length).

major_faces.name: Top major plane
major_faces.description: Large top planar surface of the tapered beam (slight tilt in +X/+Z).

major_faces.name: Side major plane (Y+)
major_faces.description: Large outer side planar surface at positive Y; forms one lateral face of the beam and continues toward ends.

major_faces.name: Bottom major plane
major_faces.description: Large bottom planar surface of the tapered beam (slight tilt in +X/-Z).

major_faces.name: Side major plane (Y-)
major_faces.description: Large outer side planar surface at negative Y; forms the opposite lateral face of the beam and continues toward ends.

Section.name: Hook / Notch End with Post
features included: Small cylindrical post/boss at the extreme end (vertical axis)
Small side trim planes near the post
Section.function intent: Provide an end-effector/interface that can capture, seat against, or apply force to a mating cylindrical/rounded feature (via the notch), while the post/boss may serve as a locator/stop or auxiliary contact feature.
Section.physical behavior: Transfers contact forces from the notched seat into the beam; the outer curved surface reduces stress concentration and provides clearance/geometry envelope. The post provides localized stiffness and a defined contact/stop surface at the end.
Section.geometry: Combination of cylindrical surfaces: a larger-radius exterior cylinder (axis Y), one or more smaller-radius cylinders forming a concave seat/transition (axis Y), and a small-radius cylindrical post (axis Z) capped by a planar top face; includes two small planar side faces at y=±3 near x~72.78.
Section.location: Positive X end of the part (approximately x from about +59.75 to +75.75).

major_faces.name: Notch/seat cylinder (main)
major_faces.description: Cylindrical surface (axis Y, radius ~3) forming part of the concave engagement/notch region near the hook end.

major_faces.name: Notch/seat cylinder (small band)
major_faces.description: Small cylindrical surface patch (axis Y, radius ~3) acting as a transition/secondary band near the top of the hook region.

major_faces.name: Outer hook cylinder
major_faces.description: Larger-radius cylindrical exterior surface (axis Y, radius ~9) defining the rounded outer profile of the hook end.

major_faces.name: Post side trim plane (Y-)
major_faces.description: Small planar face at y=-3 near the post region; likely a trimmed side/clearance face adjacent to the post.

major_faces.name: End post cylinder
major_faces.description: Vertical cylindrical surface (axis Z, radius ~3) forming the small end post/boss at extreme +X.

major_faces.name: Post side trim plane (Y+)
major_faces.description: Small planar face at y=+3 near the post region; counterpart to FACE 12.

major_faces.name: Top cap of post/end
major_faces.description: Planar top face at z=15 capping the end post/hook region.
